name: components-community-radial-intro

frames.best_why: All five circular photos sit evenly around the ring, making the orbit shape easiest to read.

tagline: Round photos glide into a ring and orbit the empty centre.
summary: A ring of circular photos spins slowly around an empty middle, each picture staying upright as the ring turns.
appearance: Five small circular photos, each a different scene, sit evenly spaced on a ring on a black background, with nothing in the middle. All circles are the same size and stay upright as they move.
behaviour: Photos fade and lift into their ring positions shortly after mount, then the whole ring rotates continuously while each photo counter-rotates so it never tips over. The linear spin never stops.
demo_content: Five circular Unsplash photos standing in for React, TypeScript, Tailwind, Vite and Node.js.
search_phrases: tech stack logos floating in orbit
rotating hero visual for landing page
photo ring that never stops spinning
use_when: A landing page or section needs a decorative orbiting visual to fill space beside copy.
avoid_when: The motion never stops and the centre is empty, so it cannot carry text and may distract from reading.
customise: Pass an array of items with id, name and src plus the stage and image sizes; the ring spacing, spring and 30-second spin are fixed in source.
weight_why: Five small images on one infinite transform spin; no canvas or WebGL.

a11y.note: The orbit never stops and there is no prefers-reduced-motion check, so motion-sensitive users cannot pause it.

issues: The demo's photos do not match their React and TypeScript names, so it reads as random scenery.
The empty centre gives the ring nothing to orbit around, so its purpose is unclear.
polish_why: Even spacing and a smooth, upright orbit; random photos and an empty centre weaken the story.
